minimalsanitized.rationale: ROOT_CAUSE - Admin can arbitrarily change ANY user's lock recipient without user consent. Rogue developer redirects all withdrawals to attacker wallet.
Impact execution path. Post-compromise function that transfers using already-manipulated recipient. Without CA1, this is benign.
Config storage setter. Latent admin capability not exercised in the actual attack - attacker used setLockRecipient (CA1) directly.
Admin transfer function. Latent capability not required for exploitation - rogue developer already had admin access.
Correctly implemented modifier. The weakness is the governance design (single admin over user funds) captured in CA1, not the modifier itself.
Standard lock function for depositing tokens.
Standard unlock function for withdrawing after lock period.
